academyImport.title: Import data
academyImport.desc: Bulk upload to migrate from another platform: your student roster and weekly schedule as CSV or Excel.
academyImport.studentsDesc: One row per student. Only email and name are required; anyone without an account gets an invite by email. They become a student once they buy a plan.
academyImport.studentsCols: Columns: email, nombre + optional: rut, fecha_nacimiento, telefono, sexo
academyImport.scheduleDesc: One row per weekly block. Rows with the same series name group into a single series of the month.
academyImport.scheduleCols: Columns: serie, dia_semana, hora_inicio, hora_fin + optional: estilo, nivel, capacidad, instructor_email, mes

scheduleValues.values: as written in your console (ignores case and accents)
email of an instructor of your academy

academyImport.previewHint: Test run: nothing was saved or sent yet. Review the result row by row and confirm with Import.
academyImport.importDoneErrors: Import completed with {errors, plural, one {# row with errors} other {# rows with errors}}.
academyImport.notFound: We couldn't find this run in the academy.
academyImport.error: Couldn't import the file. Check it's a CSV or Excel (.xls, .xlsx) with the template's columns.
academyImport.forbidden: You don't have access to this academy's import.
